record.original_question:
Let ψ be a Parseval wavelet, meaning ∑_{j,k∈Z} |⟨f, ψ_{j,k}⟩|^2 = ||f||^2 for all f ∈ L2(R), where ψ_{j,k}(x) := 2^{j/2} ψ(2^j x − k).

Define V(ψ) := span{ψ_{j,k} : j < 0, k ∈ Z}. Let D be the dilation operator (Df)(x) = √2 f(x).

Is it true that ⋂_{j∈Z} D^j(V(ψ)) = {0}?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\psi \in L^2(\mathbb{R})$ be a Parseval wavelet, that is, the family $\{\psi_{j,k} : j,k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$ defined by
$$\psi_{j,k}(x) := 2^{j/2}\psi(2^j x - k)$$
satisfies
$$\sum_{j,k \in \mathbb{Z}} |\langle f, \psi_{j,k}\rangle|^2 = \|f\|_{L^2(\mathbb{R})}^2 \quad \text{for every } f \in L^2(\mathbb{R}).$$
Define the space of negative dilates of $\psi$ by
$$V(\psi) := \overline{\operatorname{span}}\{\psi_{j,k} : j < 0,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}\} \subseteq L^2(\mathbb{R}),$$
and let $D : L^2(\mathbb{R}) \to L^2(\mathbb{R})$ denote the dyadic dilation operator $(Df)(x) = \sqrt{2}\, f(2x)$. Determine whether
$$\bigcap_{j \in \mathbb{Z}} D^j\bigl(V(\psi)\bigr) = \{0\}$$
holds for every Parseval wavelet $\psi$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the intersection of dyadic dilates of the space of negative dilates of a Parseval wavelet is trivial is listed in Bownik's compilation of open problems in wavelet theory and is connected to Baggett's problem on whether every Parseval wavelet comes from a GMRA. Available sources indicate it remains open in general, with partial results known (e.g., for shift-invariant spaces whose dimension function is not identically infinite).

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Wavelet Theory — Marcin Bownik
status_evidence.snippet: Open problem concerning the space of negative dilates (a shift invariant space in the Parseval frame wavelet case).
status_evidence.claim: The problem appears in a list of open problems in wavelet theory.

status_evidence.title: Baggett's Problem for Frame Wavelets
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates when a collection of subspaces satisfying GMRA conditions except trivial intersection must have trivial intersection; partial results.
status_evidence.claim: Related Baggett-type questions about trivial intersection of negative dilate spaces are studied with only partial results.
